title: Sidney Vinn, Matoya and the violinist Pierron
summary: Pictures she did not have; violinist Pierron with one short leg who played at West End.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Fiddlers and reading violinists of New Orleans

blocks.x: The Climbing player. The Climbing player. He got killed. Well that's Warren Bell, that's Warren Bell's uncle. You tell me about that.

Cause his daughter had asked me if I had his picture, you know. And all, but I didn't have none of them. I had this Matoya fella. You ever heard of Matoya? Oh no, Matoya. He was great, you know. And, uh, we had picture of Pierron and all that. Now he was a fine violin player. And I think a little while before he died, uh, we had read of them or he told all somebody's stories about it. It was very expensive, I think. He was great cause he played out there, uh, I'll tell you that. West End or something. I could have just, was during the place I guess, if I'd pass on there. But, um, what Pierron used to play, you know. He was a little fella, had one, one leg short and the other. You remember him?
I never saw him, but I know plenty of people worked with him.
He had a little foot, you know, and it kind of, was short and wet up, you know. But a fine little fella, fine musician.
